title: Part 6 Passage
content:
refer to the following notice.
 

NOTICE TO EMPLOYEES

The IT department maintains the proper working order of all on-site computer hardware. We also ensure that the accompanying software (131) ___ at its top level of performance.
If you are having trouble with your office computer, please contact the IT department on extension 233 and leave a message explaining the (132) ___
To best serve you, we ask you to include as many details as possible. This includes when the issue began. (133)___.The more information we have, the faster we can find a solution.
We will (134) ____ contact you to set up a time for a visit from one of our technicians.
Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.explanation: The blank needs a verb => D is correct
"Problem" means "a situation, person, or thing that needs attention and needs to be dealt with or solved" which has the most appropriate meaning

options.A: Turning your computer off and back on won’t address the issue.
options.B: Also tell us what you were doing immediately prior to it.
options.C: Moreover, improper connections could be responsible for the error.
options.D: We will try to answer any questions you have about your device.

questions.explanation: B is correct since it can connect to the previous sentence "This includes when the issue began"
"Promptly" means "quickly, without delay, or at the arranged time" which has the most appropriate meaning

title: Part 6 Passage
content:
refer to the following e-mail.

To: Vincent Silvers vsilvers@tjrprinting.com
From: Joseph Craig jcraig@tjrprinting.com
Date: June 20
Subject: Spelling error on Lambert posters

Hi Vincent,

It’s just come to my attention that there’s been a setback with the Lambert project. Apparently the posters for their product launch contain a (135)____.
The company name was typed incorrectly in the heading on the final version. As the liaison for this client, I need you to contact Mr. Lambert, notify him of the issue, and (136) ___ for the oversight.
Because we were responsible for this error, please reassure Mr. Lambert that reprinting of the posters will occur at (137) ___ expense and will be completed by the end of next week.
(138) ____.

Regards,
Joseph Craig Production Manager, TJR Printing

questions.explanation: "Misprint" means "a mistake, such as a word that is spelled wrong, in a printed text" which has the most appropriate meaning
The blank needs a verb to create a parallel structure with "contact Mr. Lambert, notify him of the issue" => D is correct
Because the subject in the previous clause is "We" (Because we were responsible for this error), we need to use the possessive adjective "our" => A is correct

options.A: Mr. Lambert has approved the final version, so this project is now complete.
options.B: Any further production complaints can be sent to me directly.
options.C: Let’s schedule a meeting to determine the appropriate solution.
options.D: Please contact me once you have received payment for the reprints.

questions.explanation: B is correct since it can connect with the previous sentence "please reassure Mr. Lambert that reprinting of the posters will occur at our expense and will be completed by the end of next week"

title: Part 6 Passage
content:
refer to the following article.

Sales Manager Wins Negotiation Prize!

Our very own Nigel Davis, head of the direct sales division, has won the National Negotiation Prize this year. In recognition of his (139) ___, he has been awarded an all-expenses-paid trip for two to Spain, where he’ll stay in a luxury hotel for seven days.
In a hotly contested final round held in New York, Davis eventually prevailed against last year’s winner, Gupta Singh. (140) ___, Davis also managed to score the highest level of points ever for this stage of the competition.(141) ___.
Davis said he is grateful for the support he has received and that he (142) ___ his time abroad.

questions.explanation: "Achievement" means "something very good and difficult that you have succeeded in doing" which has the most appropriate meaning
"In addition" is used here to add more information about Davis

options.A: This award is given out in our company each year.
options.B: His coworkers will share his responsibilities during his absence.
options.C: Mr. Davis was unavailable for comment when asked about his trip.
options.D: We are all very proud of this accomplishment.

questions.explanation: D is correct because it can connect with the previous sentence "Davis also managed to score the highest level of points ever for this stage of the competition"
The action happens in the future => Use future simple tense => D is correct

title: Part 6 Passage
content:
refer to the following instructions.

Queensville University E-Learning
E-University Software

Prospective students should visit the university Web site and download the E-University software (143) ___ onto their computers.
The software gives students access to assessments, modules, and online classrooms. Upon (144) ___, each student is provided with a brochure detailing the features of the software.
Once you have installed the program, you need to register by providing your student information as well as a username and a password. Any (145)___ login to your account will only require your username and password.
(146) ___ . Alternatively, you can call the Queensville University E-Learning Office at 555-9090.

questions.explanation: "Directly" means "without anything else being involved or in between" which has the most appropriate meaning
"Subsequent" means "happening after something else" which has the most appropriate meaning

options.A: The software must be purchased before the end of the month.
options.B: Usernames are the same as your university-assigned student number.
options.C: If you experience any problems with the software, e-mail it@quelearning.edu.
options.D: The software can be installed on a maximum of two computers.

questions.explanation: C is correct because it can connect with the sentence after it "Alternatively, you can call the Queensville University E-Learning Office at 555-9090."
